statements.text: But what are you doing to deal with threats as it relates to drones powered by AI to identify specific vessels or individuals in uniforms, things like that? [...] Sir, you asked about the concerns about countering UAS or UAS threat, and we are also concerned about that. [...] But that is not enough capacity. My concern is we have got to scale and we have got to scale fast to address the kind of evolving dynamic threat that we have seen, that was reflected, as you said, sir, in the dynamic strike that we have seen news reports of from Ukraine into Russia.
statements.context: House Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation Subcommittee hearing on Coast Guard programs and structure, featuring Rep. Mast questioning Admiral Lunday on maritime security threats.
